verdict.rationale: Shortwave documents triggers that act automatically when emails arrive: drafting replies, adding team comments, organizing threads into todos, and connecting to 3,000+ apps. It also documents custom AI filters, written as plain-English scripts, that automatically label, star and archive mail, and a Tasklet integration that acts on emails automatically. This covers the core of defining rules that fire actions on events. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on trigger configuration and the range of supported events beyond email arrival, and independent or hands-on corroboration that these rules work as claimed.
